fixture.selection_policy: first file-order formal prediction resolving to exact split=val, view_kind=full, non-empty GT, with at least three detections at fixed score>=0.80 and no prediction within 0.05 of that replay floor

limitations: This is runtime/replay evidence only; it cannot register, bless, or promote the candidate.
The fixed high-confidence replay subset checks CUDA-to-CPU stability and is not a replacement for full frozen-validation metrics.
The official competition evaluator is unavailable; no official score is claimed.
Only one frozen validation view is decoded; train and test rows are not loaded or scored.
